candidate_relations.reason: Metabolic acidosis was present on arterial blood gas but is not the final diagnosis explaining the post-ascent syndrome.

candidate_relations.scope_detail: Nitrogen bubble formation is an etiologic mechanism within decompression sickness

candidate_relations.reason: Caisson disease denotes decompression sickness caused by rapid reduction in ambient pressure.

High-pressure nervous syndrome is associated with descent and high ambient pressure, whereas symptoms began after rapid ascent with decompression microbubbles.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Pressure-related neurologic syndrome occurring during compression or sustained high pressure rather than decompression
